stories.headline: Government faces opposition pressure over Adamuz train accident response
stories.summary: Sánchez will appear in Congress February 11 to explain the Adamuz accident response. Opposition demands Transport Minister Puente's resignation while families of the 45 victims send emotional letters criticizing the government's handling. Sánchez broke 48 hours of silence to attend a UN women's event rather than victims' funeral.

stories.summary: Belén Navarro, a PP councilor from Valencia, shouted 'hijo de puta' at Pedro Sánchez during a PSOE campaign event in Teruel supporting Pilar Alegría. She later apologized through a statement. PSOE demands Feijóo condemn the incident and expel her from the party.

stories.headline: Government and Podemos agree to regularize 500,000 undocumented migrants
stories.summary: Sánchez government reaches agreement with Podemos to regularize approximately half a million undocumented immigrants. Opposition parties, led by Feijóo and Abascal, strongly criticize the measure, with Feijóo taking concerns to European level and Abascal calling it an 'invasion.' Critics argue it's designed to distract from train accident crisis.

stories.headline: King Felipe VI celebrates 58th birthday while working
stories.summary: King Felipe VI turned 58 on January 30, spending the day working with a meeting with Slovenia's president. When reporters wished him happy birthday, he jokingly replied '58 doesn't weigh too much.' The milestone comes after presiding over the emotional Adamuz victims' funeral with Queen Letizia.

stories.headline: Isabel Sartorius hospitalized in psychiatric facility
stories.summary: Isabel Sartorius, King Felipe VI's former girlfriend, has been admitted to a psychiatric facility in Madrid due to health issues. The 61-year-old aristocrat, who was the King's first public romance, is receiving treatment with supervised outings. Her health deteriorated significantly in 2024.

stories.headline: Feijóo campaigns in Aragón while taking EU-level action on Spanish policies

At Zagreb EPP summit, he requested EU investigation into Adamuz accident and review of immigration regularization policy.

stories.headline: Aznar criticizes Sánchez's defense spending position in French media
stories.summary: Former President José María Aznar accused Pedro Sánchez of 'sectarian uselessness' for opposing NATO's 5% defense spending commitment. In an interview with French newspaper Le Journal du Dimanche, Aznar called Sánchez a 'radical populist' and 'a danger to democracy'.

articles.title: Aznar acusa a Sánchez de "sectarismo inútil" por negarse a gastar el 5% en defensa

stories.headline: ERC demands Transport Minister's resignation over Catalonia rail chaos
stories.summary: ERC, the government's key partner, breaks with Sánchez over the railway crisis affecting Catalonia's Rodalies service. Party leader Oriol Junqueras demands the resignation of Transport Minister Óscar Puente, showing 'manifest incapacity' in handling the crisis despite their earlier fiscal agreement.

stories.headline: US approves Spanish frigate modernization worth 1.42 billion euros
stories.summary: The US State Department approved the sale of systems worth 1.42 billion euros for the mid-life modernization of Spain's F-100 frigates. The package includes AEGIS systems, Mk 41 vertical launchers, surface radars, and communications technology, allowing the ships to operate until 2040.

stories.headline: CNI dismisses trainee deemed unsuitable for intelligence work
stories.summary: The National Court ruled in favor of Spain's National Intelligence Centre (CNI) in dismissing a female trainee who was deemed not 'suitable' to become a spy. The woman had failed to pass security clearance filters during her 2024 training course and unsuccessfully challenged the decision.

articles.title: El CNI expulsa a una becaria por no ser «idónea» para ser espía
